settings.label: Text-TV proxy host
settings.help: Board serving /api/texttv over plain HTTP. Loopback: the door runs beside the board (container or localhost), where the public hostname hairpins and stalls. Point at the LAN IP for a classic Amiga.

settings.label: Port
settings.help: 3001 is the board's backend port, plain HTTP, on this host and live.

settings.label: Start page
settings.help: Page the door opens on. 100 is the news front.

settings.label: Favorite pages
settings.help: Comma-separated page numbers a new board starts with, kept in the index below the curated list. A caller's own F list lives in TEXTTV.favs beside the door and is not overwritten by this - the two used to share TEXTTV.cfg, and every boot reverted what the callers had pressed.
